title: Liapoldus security runtime contract

flow: Unauthenticated browser request generates 256-bit state and nonce, stores them only in state cookie, then returns 302 to discovery authorization_endpoint with response_type=code, client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state and nonce.
Gateway intercepts only the exact scheme, host and path of redirectUri on the listener selected by normal routing; its callback handler runs before route terminal.

Callback requires code and state. Missing/mismatched/expired state returns 400 oidc_state_invalid. Provider error returns 401 oidc_provider_error. Valid authorization code is exchanged server-side, ID token nonce/signature/issuer/audience/expiry are verified, and session cookie is issued before 302 to the original safe relative path.
Logout at /.well-known/liapoldus/logout clears session with Max-Age=0 and returns 302 to discovery end_session_endpoint when present, otherwise /.
oidc.identityHeaders: No identity header is implicit. A proxy may forward only route proxy.requestHeaders. Gateway-generated values are x-liapoldus-subject and x-liapoldus-claim-<claim>, and are available only when exactly listed; client values with those names are removed first.

modes.require: missing or invalid client certificate is 401 mtls_required
modes.optional: missing certificate is allowed; supplied certificate must validate

mtls.identity: RE2 mapping applies to verified certificate subject/SAN only.

sourceIp: The TCP/UDP peer address is sourceIp. X-Forwarded-For is never trusted for auth, WAF, rate-limit source-ip or geo/ASN lookup.

geo.asn: non-negative integer returned by the local MaxMind MMDB reader
geo.reload: A new MMDB is opened and checked before atomic replacement; a failed reload keeps the old reader. With no reader or failed lookup, the matching WAF rule applies its onError.

tls.storage: ${registry.path}/tls/<storage>/{accounts,certificates,orders}/. Files containing account or private keys are mode 0600 and owned by the Gateway user. Plugins receive opaque handles only.
tls.sni: Choose exact DNS SAN first; otherwise the longest matching wildcard SAN. No matching certificate fails TLS handshake.
tls.http3: protocols including h3 requires a terminating TLS profile and binds TCP and UDP on the same listener address. QUIC limits are listener.limits.quic; TCP limits still apply independently.
tls.degraded: Repeated renew failure while a valid certificate exists is degraded and serves the valid certificate. At expiry Gateway stops new handshakes for affected SNI, returns tls_degraded where HTTP is possible, emits alert/audit and expiry metric.
